claims: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to orbit the Moon since the end of the Apollo program.
Artemis II breaks a 53-year streak of no crewed missions to orbit the Moon.
Artemis II will feature Christina Koch as the first woman to journey beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis II will feature Victor Glover as the first person of color to journey beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis II will feature Jeremy Hansen as the first Canadian to journey beyond low Earth orbit.
The Artemis II crew includes commander Reid Wiseman.
The Artemis II crew includes the first non-American astronaut from the Canadian Space Agency to go to the Moon.
Artemis II is a test flight for the Orion spacecraft's life support systems with humans on board.
The Artemis II mission will take the crew around the far side of the Moon.
Artemis II is a nine-and-a-half-day mission.
